card.name: Nouns before 'of' or 'to' phrases
card.fires_on: A noun or word-part that is about to be followed by a linking word like 'of', 'from' or 'to', in stock label phrases such as 'signs of', 'range in severity from', 'refractory to'.

modes.label: Signs of / performance of
modes.description: A noun right before 'of' in a label sentence.
modes.example: Observe newborns for<< signs>> of neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome and manage

modes.label: Range in severity
modes.description: The word 'severity' in the C. difficile diarrhea warning, followed by 'from'.
modes.example: and may range in<< severity>> from mild diarrhea to fatal colitis.

modes.label: Reference to
modes.description: A noun or word-part that leads into 'to' and a following phrase.
modes.example: will best be understood by<< reference>> to the following detailed description of an illustr

card.writes: It seems to raise the chance of opening quote marks, though the link to these contexts is weak.
